scope: Only active when body has desert-theme class or localStorage yamb_theme is desert.

packs.description: Original sculpted desert background with dunes, wind-carved sand, sun and sandstone relief.

All room and game-mode entries now use the dedicated restrained Desert Soft Clay Relief 3D language. The four main game modes keep the proven Easter card dimensions, positions, title alignment and motion while using Desert-only assets without decorative backplates.

Five professional matte-clay icons for Daily Challenge, Leaderboard, Statistics, Settings and Rules. They use sandstone, cream, terracotta and muted turquoise without jewelry, gemstones, ornate gold or Easter motifs; their 44x44 slots, positions, click geometry and sequential 8.4-second wave motion exactly match the Easter Theme Pack.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Daily Challenge intro plus room, task, already-played, completion and rewarded-video Soft Clay assets. Layout, spacing and visual dimensions match the proven Easter room parameters while all game logic remains shared and unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Top List intro, Desert header and Global/Local icons, empty/loading state, themed list contrast and shared neutral YotB gold/silver/bronze podium medals. Waiting Top 3 uses the same podium and state system.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Statistics intro; Desert header, overview, record, games, result, average, trophies, ducats, All-Time PTS, H2H and empty-state Soft Clay assets; one themed swords icon on the left of the H2H title without a duplicate legacy symbol; plus separate lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak gold/silver/bronze podium mini-packs.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Settings intro plus Desert header, profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy Soft Clay assets. Switches, theme select, name field, Google account data, language flags, links and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Global Chat intro plus a clean standalone 44px main-menu icon without a rear bubble or decorative backplate, Desert room-header icon, centered send icon and empty/loading state illustration. Close, character counter, online indicator, report control, avatars and chat logic remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second Desert Online Players intro plus Desert main-menu/header icon, Add Friend, Watch Match and Challenge to Duel action icons, muted unavailable variants, infinite progressive player list, name search filter and empty/loading state. Status colors, avatars, player data and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated restrained matte-clay Desert YotB QL Pack: a new 4.6-second intro, watermark and header emblem; standalone Liga, Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions tab icons without ornamental backplates; six standardized rank badges from Amateur through Titan plus All Time; and a matching gold, silver and bronze clay podium set used in rankings, Hall of Fame and quarter-end notifications. Purple Easter wave colors, jewels, crowns, laurels, glossy gold and inherited dark tab/pagination bands are excluded.

Dedicated restrained matte-clay Desert Dukati / Ispravi zadnji upis pack: a new 4.6-second two-line intro and separate ducat, undo-token, rewarded-video and unavailable-ad assets without pink, purple, bows, gift ornament or glossy Easter treatment. The active tab switches the room-header icon; balance, +500, Vaši tokeni and +1 use the same pack; unavailable rewards keep a readable warm-sand surface instead of the global gray/hourglass state.

Dedicated Desert Soft Clay main-menu and final-score marks plus a restrained personal-best badge. Solo keeps direct entry without an additional room intro and preserves the board, dice skin, scoring, controls, resume/new-game behavior and dimensions.

Dedicated Desert two-player Soft Clay mark, standard 4.6-second room intro and winner result mark. Both boards, manual swipe, automatic active-player tracking, turn status, controls, results and all dimensions remain shared and unchanged.

Dedicated Desert globe/search pack for main menu, 4.6-second intro, waiting header, scanning, found-opponent, spectating, disconnect and reconnect states. Player cards, full names, Power/POB/NER/POR layout, connection status colors, dual-board swipe and automatic turn tracking remain unchanged, while the working online duel countdown uses the same fixed-width pill geometry as the spectator LIVE badge in Desert colors.

Dedicated Desert invite pack for main menu, 4.6-second intro, room header, add, send, sent, accepted and empty states. Owner/top-rival and friend-card geometry matches Easter while using Desert surfaces; avatars, full names, statistics, room code, safe-zone spacing and invitation logic remain unchanged.

True Soft Clay Relief 3D Desert Treasury Pack: fully rounded matte-clay chest with micro-texture, soft bevels, upper-left studio lighting and ambient-occlusion depth for main menu, intro and header; matching Trofeji, Skinovi, Efekti and Teme tabs; owned, active, locked and insufficient-funds states; and neutral bronze, silver and gold collection marks. No flat vector substitutes, jewels, ornate gold, crowns, laurels, purple Easter decoration or decorative icon backplates.

True Soft Clay Relief 3D Desert Tournament Pack: fully rounded matte-clay trophy with the same material, lighting and depth as the five bottom-room icons; matching Info/Bracket/Hall of Fame tabs, registration and match states, numbered gold/silver/bronze podium medals and plain silver finalist badge. No flat vector substitutes, jewels, ornate frames, crowns, laurels or Easter-style decoration.

Desert-only Rules identity matching the Easter implementation pattern: 4.6-second room intro, header icon, six dedicated page/title assets under desert-soft-clay/rules/pages, compact inline room/action/state icons, Desert QL reward podium medals and all referenced Desert assets for Online Players, Global Chat, Add Friend, Spectate, Duel, H2H, Fire Streak, All-Time PTS, Treasury tabs, Economy icons, rewarded video and connection states. Rule text, numbering, lists, swipe, pagination dots, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged; other themes keep their own icon layers.
Sandstone-and-glass board, dice, score cells, HUD and controls without changing board dimensions.
Cards, typography, inputs, modals, notifications, chat, treasury, stats, rules and leaderboard contrast.
Splash, quote, waiting and game-over screens with the same desert visual language.
Soft dune-rise, glass-glint, hover and waiting motion with reduced-motion fallback.
Desert-styled loading, empty and fallback states.
Procedural warm desert-glass cues for click, roll, score, announce, win, error and trophy.
Final screenshot set: splash, quote, main menu, board, leaderboard, settings, stats, treasury, chat, waiting and game-over.

designTokens.shapeLanguage: rounded glass badges, pills and inset sandstone surfaces
designTokens.shadowLanguage: soft raised and inset desert neumorphism

rules: Do not change global theme icons as the base game style.
Keep all Desert Glass styling isolated under body.desert-theme.

The bottom room row from Daily Challenge through Rules uses clean standalone 44x44 Soft Clay Relief icons with the same layout and dimensions as Easter, but a restrained sandstone/terracotta/turquoise palette and no decorative backplates or kitsch ornament.

The five Desert bottom-room icons use the same staggered 8.4-second wave as Easter: only the visible icon moves, while button positions and click targets remain fixed; reduced-motion disables the animation.
Daily Challenge uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, large-icon dimensions, title spacing and left-to-right letter wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, colors and background.
Inside Daily Challenge, use the Desert room, task, already-played, completion and rewarded-video icons without changing dice, scoring, timer, reward amount or functional controls.
Top List uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but the Desert leaderboard icon, background and palette.
Inside Top List, use Desert Global, Local and empty/loading assets while keeping week/month/all-time filters textual and preserving avatars, names, scores, ordering and data-source logic.
Use the shared neutral YotB leaderboard podium medals for the first three places in both the Top List and Waiting Top 3; only surrounding surfaces and rank-number contrast follow the Desert palette.
Statistics uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Statistics, use Desert Soft Clay category and H2H assets plus dedicated lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak podium sets, while preserving graphs, progress bars, values, POB/NER/POR semantic colors, swipe behavior, card dimensions and ranking logic.
Settings uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, spacing and left-to-right title wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Settings, use Desert Soft Clay icons for profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy while preserving SRB/ENG flags, switches, theme select, name input, Google account data, links and close control.

Global Chat uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, icon/title dimensions and wave as Easter, with a clean standalone 44px Desert room icon, without a rear bubble or decorative backplate, aligned to the Online Players card edge.

Inside Global Chat, use Desert Soft Clay header, send and empty/loading icons while preserving close, character counter, online indicator and status dot, report control, avatars, message layout and chat logic.
Online Players uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Online Players, keep the Easter search-filter position and dimensions, progressively render the complete live player list, fit long full names without changing avatar/action slots, and use Desert Soft Clay Add Friend, Watch Match, Challenge to Duel and empty/loading assets while preserving semantic player status colors and all socket actions.

Quarterly League uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, YotB QL logo dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, with the Desert logo used consistently as the main-menu watermark, room header and quarter-winner mark.

Inside Quarterly League, use Desert Liga, Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions icons; persistent Amateur, Pro, Master, Legend, Titan and All Time badges; and the Desert QL podium medals while preserving real progress, points, rank names, avatars, pagination dots, swipe, infinite progressive lists and reward logic.
Dukati / Ispravi zadnji upis uses the same 4.6-second two-line intro, dimensions, spacing and title wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside the economy room, switch the Desert ducat/token header icon with the active tab and use the same Desert assets for balance, +500, Vaši tokeni, +1, rewarded video and unavailable-ad states; disabled rewards must use a readable warm-sand surface and the Desert unavailable-ad icon, never the global gray card or hourglass/ornamental fallback. Preserve counts, prices, ad availability, text, + quantities, close control and undo logic.

Solo, Two Players Hotseat, Find Opponent and Invite Friend use the exact proven Easter card dimensions, positions, icon slots, centered-title rows and resume/new-game geometry, with Desert-only matte Soft Clay assets and no decorative icon backplates.
Solo keeps direct entry without a new room intro. Hotseat, Find Opponent and Invite Friend use the shared 4.6-second large-icon intro with the same title spacing and wave timing as Easter.

Hotseat, online duels and spectating preserve manual swipe between both boards and automatic following of the active player; theme styling must never replace, disable or intercept that shared behavior.

Find Opponent preserves player cards, full-name fitting, Power/POB/NER/POR data, connection colors, timer and X control while using Desert scanning, found, spectating, disconnected and reconnected marks.
Invite Friend preserves owner, greatest-rival and friend-card data, room code, safe-zone spacing and invitation logic while using Desert add, send, sent, accepted and empty-state marks.
Riznica uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, large-icon dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, but only Desert assets, background and palette.

Inside Riznica, use the restrained matte-clay Desert header, Trofeji/Skinovi/Efekti/Teme tabs, owned/active/locked/insufficient states and neutral bronze/silver/gold collection marks without jewels, ornate gold, crowns, laurels, purple decoration or decorative icon backplates; preserve shared rewarded-video and Ducat assets until the Economy room audit, plus actual dice skins, theme/effect previews, prices, buying/equipping logic and collectible trophy visuals.

Turnir uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, large-icon dimensions, centered icon/title position, title spacing, wave and real server-provided Top 3 card as Easter. The Top 3 card stays anchored 2 mm above the bottom safe zone and does not push the large icon or title downward; the icon language is restrained Desert matte clay without jewelry or ornamental Easter styling, and the 62px main-menu icon has no card or inner backplate.

Inside Turnir, use simplified Desert Info, Bracket and Hall of Fame tabs; register, unregister/refund, locked registration, start, active-match and completed-match states; clear numbered gold/silver/bronze podium medals only for the all-time tournament ranking; and only a clean champion trophy plus plain silver finalist badge for an individual tournament result. Preserve the bracket and lines, quarterfinal/semifinal/final layout, avatars, names, scores, match times, reward logic and phase swipe.

Rules uses Desert-only Soft Clay header, page/title, room, action, state and QL podium assets through the same isolated layer as Easter, including the same 4.6-second large-icon intro with the Desert rules mark. Old SVG/emoji symbols are hidden only under body.desert-theme, while text, numbering, lists, swipe, pagination dots, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged.

Every active two-player online match in Desert uses the same fixed-width pill geometry as the spectator LIVE badge for its working turn countdown, but rendered with Desert danger/cream colors. My-turn, opponent-turn and urgent states keep identical dimensions; urgent pulse and countdown logic remain unchanged, while reconnection messages retain their wider dedicated layout.
Do not change game board/card dimensions or layout unless explicitly requested.
Desert background is separate from translucent glass treatments used only on UI elements.
Keep contrast readable on all light sand and glass surfaces.
